data.name: Louis
data.gender_notes: Louis is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic hlud, 'fame', + wig, 'war' — 'famous warrior'. Its root is Germanic hlud + wig. Saint Louis IX, king of France. Louis is a Germanic name meaning “Famous warrior”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Louis expresses “Famous warrior”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Germanic hlud, 'fame', + wig, 'war' — 'famous warrior'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Louis total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
